description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.60 each), grants [Attach Holy], [Awoken Highborn], [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Regenga] to all allies

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Highborn
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[15% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[30% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using a Holy ability at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5
